programme.desc: Honest IPS officer Amit Kumar is posted to a crime-ridden town to restore order. Battling corrupt cops, powerful politicians, and ruthless criminals, he risks everything to uphold justice.

programme.title: Kasoor
programme.desc: Accused of murdering his wife, Shekhar hires Simran, a brilliant lawyer with an unbroken record. As she defends him and grows close to him, she remains unaware of his hidden intentions.

programme.title: Phone Bhoot
programme.desc: Inspired by stories from their childhood, two young men create a business around capturing ghosts. However, their endeavour turns dangerous when they must fulfil their promise to a poltergeist.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Sooraj, the gangster Suryakant Pasha's son, kidnaps Radha, the police chief's daughter. As they spend time together, they fall in love, while both the police and Pasha's men chase them down.

programme.title: India's Best Resorts
programme.desc: A travel-based series showcasing breathtaking destinations, luxurious stays, unique experiences, and inspiring journeys that highlight the beauty and culture of diverse resorts.

programme.title: English Vinglish
programme.desc: Film about a housewife who enrols in an English-speaking course to stop her husband and daughter mocking her lack of English skills, and gains self-respect in the process.

programme.title: Encounter Man 2
programme.desc: Gautham an NRI businessman's son faces kidnapping in India.

programme.title: Operation Java
programme.desc: A team of police officers from the Kochi cyber cell embarks on a mission to investigate a series of mysterious crimes and unlawful activities.

programme.title: Hum Chaar
programme.desc: Abeer, Namir, Manjari and Surjo develop a close bond with each other. Though they come across several obstacles in life, they always support each other.

programme.title: Guna 369
programme.desc: The life of Guna turns upside down when he is falsely framed for a murder and imprisoned. After his release, he sets off to hunt the real culprits.

programme.title: Khatta Meetha

programme.title: Aranmanai 4
programme.desc: After his sister's suspicious death, a man decides to discover the hidden truth, setting off a chasm for chaos and terror.

programme.title: Kumki 2

programme.title: Radhe
programme.desc: After taking the dreaded gangster Gani Bhai, ACP Rajveer Shikawat aka Radhe goes on a manhunt to find the wealthiest man of the town secretly running a crime syndicate.

programme.title: Baaghi 4
programme.desc: A fearless rebel returns stronger than ever to battle powerful enemies and injustice, leading explosive action, intense fights and a fight for justice.

programme.title: The Akaali

programme.title: Apna Sapna Money Money

programme.title: Aravind Sametha
